answer_1.quote: Document Image Machine Translation (DIMT) aims to translate text within document images from one language to another while preserving the logical layout
answer_1.outputs: translated text in the target language with preserved document layout

answer_2.quote: We thoroughly evaluate the models' capabilities in three aspects: (1) full-text translation, which means the translation quality of all the text in the image -BLEU and COMET . (2) plain-text translation, which means the translation quality of the text after removing formulas and tables -BLEU-PT. (3) structure preserving, which means the model's ability to restore the layout structure of the document images -STEDS
